entries.content:
I can’t identify the cause of this particular missed run from [B_255](/C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/design/feature_descriptions/B_255_scheduled_task_did_not_start.md:15). It records only that a task scheduled for an hour later that day did not start; it gives no schedule ID, selected time, schedule status, or runtime error.

The code converts the entered local time to a timestamp, registers a desktop timer, and re-registers pending timers when the project loads ([time conversion](/C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/components/actions/run/schedule/action_schedule_trigger.ts:10), [timer registration](/C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/desktop/src/actions/schedule/schedule_timers.js:27), [project startup](/C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/desktop/src/actions/action/action_scheduler_service.js:122)). That trace does not establish why this task was missed. The persisted `.md2-schedules.json` record and an error or run log from the scheduled time are needed to distinguish a timer that never fired from an action that failed to start. I made no file changes.
